rationale: The bid-ask spread of 150 bps is extremely wide, creating an immediate structural disadvantage that makes any entry highly unfavorable — the spread alone consumes a significant portion of any realistic intraday move. The single 1-minute candle available shows a wide-ranging bar with no clear directional conviction, and the last price at $33.96 sitting exactly at the ask suggests thin liquidity and potential for adverse fills. With no news catalyst and insufficient price action data to establish a reliable thesis, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
